channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Bureaucrats shouldn’t stand between smokers and safer choices
item.description: Smokers should not have to fight bureaucracy to reach safer choices. Regulation has a role in setting standards, preventing youth access and protecting consumers, but it should not become a barrier that leaves cigarettes as the easiest product to buy. Harm reduction depends on making lower-risk alternatives available, understandable and legally viable. Public health loses its purpose when process blocks the very options that could reduce harm. (Published on August 27, 2026byocregister.com)

item.title: Op-Ed: Harry Shapiro – Global State of Tobacco Harm Reduction
item.description: The new Global State of Tobacco Harm Reduction report points to a movement that continues despite resistance, denial and political discomfort. Around the world, people are moving away from cigarettes through safer nicotine products, even where policy has been slow to recognise the shift. That progress should not be ignored because it challenges older tobacco-control assumptions. Harm reduction is no longer a marginal idea; it is part of the real-world response to smoking. (Published on August 27, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)
